title: Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus
description: Send and receive messages with Azure Service Bus queues and topics.

data.text: `Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus` is the modern SDK for Azure Service Bus. It supports queues, topics, subscriptions, sessions, and transactions.
Use `ServiceBusSender` to send messages to a queue or topic.

data.title: Send and Receive Messages

terms.definition: The main client for connecting to a Service Bus namespace.
Sends messages to a queue or topic.
Continuously receives and processes messages from a queue or subscription.

data.title: Important
data.text: Always call `CompleteMessageAsync` after successfully processing a message, or it will be redelivered.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use `ServiceBusClient` to connect to your Service Bus namespace.
Sessions and transactions are supported for complex workflows.
data.takeaway: Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus makes it easy to add reliable messaging to your .NET applications.

data.title: Exercise: Send and Receive a Service Bus Message
data.description: Create a console app that sends a message to a Service Bus queue and receives it.
steps: Create a ServiceBusClient with your connection string.
Send a message to a queue.
Receive and print the message using ServiceBusProcessor.
data.expectedOutcome: You understand the basic send and receive workflow for Azure Service Bus.
